visual.description: Pure white used as the main page background for content sections and footer
Off-white light grey used as the product card section background
Pure black used for large display headings and the oversized Opal wordmark in the footer
Near-black used for body copy, product names, and nav items on white backgrounds
Medium grey used for product subtitles and secondary descriptive text
Bright yellow used exclusively for primary CTA buttons and price tags throughout the site
Black pill button used for the newsletter subscribe arrow CTA in the footer
Light grey used for card borders and subtle dividing lines between sections
Very dark warm-tinted black that forms the dominant tone of the full-bleed hero photography section
White text used for logo, nav links, and menu items when nav overlays the dark hero image
Transparent nav over dark hero — effectively white text on dark photographic background
Black text for logo and nav links once the page scrolls into white background sections
Blue tint visible on the Opal logo wordmark when rendered over the white product section, indicating a brand accent color
